info.title: Binacle.Net API v4
info.description:
Binacle.Net is an API created to address the 3D Bin Packing Problem in real time.

**Warning: This API version is experimental and may change any time, introducing breaking changes.**



[View on Github](https://github.com/ChrisMavrommatis/Binacle.Net)

[🐳 Binacle.Net on Dockerhub](https://hub.docker.com/r/binacle/binacle-net)

get.description: Gets the bins configured for a single preset.

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: Name of the preset to use.

Algorithm.description: The packing heuristic. FFD, WFD and BFD are the individual heuristics; Best runs more than one and keeps the best result - all three on fit/bin and pack/bin, FFD plus BFD on every other route.

id.description: Caller-supplied identifier, echoed back on the matching result so requests and responses can be correlated.

length.description: Length of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

width.description: Width of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

height.description: Height of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

Bin.description: A bin (container) to pack items into or fit items against.

BinFitEarlyExitReason.description: Why a fit check stopped early, or None if it ran to completion.

id.description: Caller-supplied identifier, echoed back on the matching result so requests and responses can be correlated.

quantity.description: Number of identical items of this type.

length.description: Length of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

width.description: Width of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

height.description: Height of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

Box.description: An item to pack or fit, with its dimensions and quantity.

bin.description: The bin these results are for.

algorithmUsed.description: The algorithm actually used for this result. When Best is requested, this is the heuristic that won.

packedItems.description: Items placed in the bin, each with its placement.

unpackedItems.description: Items that could not be placed in the bin.

packedItemsVolumePercentage.description: Percentage of the items' volume that was packed (0-100).

packedBinVolumePercentage.description: Percentage of the bin's volume filled by the packed items (0-100).

viPaqData.description: The packing result encoded as a ViPaq protocol token (Base64). Present only when requested.

earlyExitReason.description: Why a fit check stopped early, or None if it ran to completion.

FitBinResponse.description: The result of fitting items into a single bin.

FitCompareResponse.description: The fit result for each bin considered.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

bin.description: The bin these results are for.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

FitPresetBinRequest.description: A request to check whether items fit into a bin from a preset.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

FitPresetCompareRequest.description: A request to check whether items fit into each bin of a preset.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

FitPresetSmallestBinRequest.description: A request to check the smallest fitting bin of a preset.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type (RFC 7807).

status.description: The HTTP status code for this problem (RFC 7807).

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence (RFC 7807).

instance.description: A URI reference identifying the specific occurrence of the problem (RFC 7807).

errors.description: Validation errors, keyed by the field that failed.

HttpValidationProblemDetails.description: An RFC 7807 problem-details response that also lists per-field validation errors.

algorithm.description: The heuristic algorithm to use: FFD, WFD, BFD, or Best to run more than one and keep the best result. Best runs all three on fit/bin and pack/bin, and FFD plus BFD on every other route.

includeViPaqData.description: When true, the packing result includes its ViPaq data token.

OperationParameters.description: Options that control how the operation runs.

bin.description: The bin these results are for.

algorithmUsed.description: The algorithm actually used for this result. When Best is requested, this is the heuristic that won.

packedItems.description: Items placed in the bin, each with its placement.

unpackedItems.description: Items that could not be placed in the bin.

packedItemsVolumePercentage.description: Percentage of the items' volume that was packed (0-100).

packedBinVolumePercentage.description: Percentage of the bin's volume filled by the packed items (0-100).

viPaqData.description: The packing result encoded as a ViPaq protocol token (Base64). Present only when requested.

PackBinResponse.description: The result of packing items into a single bin.

PackCompareResponse.description: The packing result for each bin considered.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackCustomBestBinRequest.description: A request to pack items into the best of several custom bins.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

bin.description: The bin these results are for.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackCustomBinRequest.description: A request to pack items into a custom bin.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackCustomCompareRequest.description: A request to pack items into each of several custom bins.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackCustomSmallestBinRequest.description: A request to pack items into the smallest fitting custom bin.

id.description: Caller-supplied identifier, echoed back on the matching result so requests and responses can be correlated.

length.description: Length of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

width.description: Width of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

height.description: Height of the bin or item, in the same unit as the other dimensions.

x.description: Placement of the item along the length axis, measured from the bin origin.

y.description: Placement of the item along the width axis, measured from the bin origin.

z.description: Placement of the item along the height axis, measured from the bin origin.

PackedBox.description: An item placed inside the bin, with its position.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackPresetBestBinRequest.description: A request to pack items into the best bin of a preset.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackPresetBinRequest.description: A request to pack items into a bin from a preset.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackPresetCompareRequest.description: A request to pack items into each bin of a preset.

parameters.description: Options controlling the operation, such as the algorithm to use.

items.description: The items to fit or pack.

PackPresetSmallestBinRequest.description: A request to pack items into the smallest fitting bin of a preset.

presets.description: The presets configured on the server.

PresetListResponse.description: The presets configured on the server.

PresetResponse.description: A preset and the bins it contains.

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type (RFC 7807).

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type (RFC 7807).

status.description: The HTTP status code for this problem (RFC 7807).

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence (RFC 7807).

instance.description: A URI reference identifying the specific occurrence of the problem (RFC 7807).

ProblemDetails.description: An error response in RFC 7807 problem-details format.

id.description: Caller-supplied identifier, echoed back on the matching result so requests and responses can be correlated.

quantity.description: Number of identical items of this type.

UnpackedBox.description: An item that could not be placed in the bin.
